evidence.limits: One still per side/status cannot establish animation continuity or every pulse phase. Existing lifecycle evidence is visual input, not a new duration-authority test.

policy.onOvercorrection: Stop and revert only the demonstrated overcorrected portion; unrelated authorized work continues.
noGeneralRollback: Do not restore global CSS top:42% or duplicate positioning owners.
Do not roll back all status presentation profiles.
Do not replace existing sources simply to satisfy an arbitrary margin/detail preference.
Do not use runtime/lifecycle technical success as commercial visual acceptance.
